title: An Euler scheme for McKean SDEs with Besov drift: convergence rate and implementation
summary: We study a one-dimensional McKean-Vlasov stochastic differential equation (SDE) with a drift equal to a product of a distribution depending on the state of the process and a non-linear function depending pointwise on the law density of the solution. Building on recent well-posedness results, we propose the first implementable numerical scheme for this class of SDEs. Our approach combines mollification of the distributional drift with the Euler-Maruyama scheme and a PDE-based approximation of the law via the associated Fokker-Planck equation.
